items.html: Thus it is found that, in truth, Abba is the collective of AVI Ila'in, the Yod of the Name, and Ima is the collective of Yeshsut and Tvuna, the first Hei of the Name. But at times we call “Abba” both Abba and Yeshsut, since both are the Bina of MA, and “Ima,” both Bina and Tvuna, since both are only the aspect of BON, which is female. From this, understand what is said elsewhere, on “Abba is not in the city, etc.,” for the coupling of Yeshsut and Tvuna is a coupling that never ceases, as is known, and is called the coupling of Bina and Bina, as above. But “Abba is not in the city” refers to Chochma with Bina, which is the coupling of AVI Ila'in, whose coupling does cease. It is known from another discourse that Ima comes out from between the arms of Abba, which is the secret of Yeshsut, called: Ima comes out from beneath the two arms of AVI Ila'in, both of whom are called simply Abba.
